title: Cindy's Hot Shots
specs: Two newly renovated heated indoor 25-yard ranges with 24 lanes
Allows rifles up to .300 Winchester Magnum and shotguns with restrictions
Must be 21 or older to rent a handgun
Must be 18 or older to rent a rifle or long gun
Children 12 and older may shoot if accompanied by parent or legal guardian
No one prohibited from owning or purchasing firearms allowed
Instructor fee $25 per person; waived if instructor is member
Groups of 15+ must book after-hours range time in advance
blurb: Cindy's Hot Shots offers two heated indoor 25-yard shooting ranges with 24 lanes total. They provide handguns, rifles, and shotguns for rental and allow guests to bring their own firearms. They offer classes from beginner to expert and memberships with benefits including unlimited range time and discounts.
extraNote: No reservations; members may be added to wait list if busy · Outside instructors must have insurance with minimum $1,000,000 per occurrence · No black powder firearms allowed · No steel core, bi-metal jacketed, armor-piercing, tracer, or bird shot ammo allowed · Alcohol and drugs prohibited on premises · Training center for fingerprinting: 201 Holsum Way, Glen Burnie, MD 21060
